description: Artifact build-out order and the conditions that would change it (AES-P1.5 / SUE-442). Provisional and evidence-revisable — an input to the P4 PoC, not a permanent assumption.

evidence.rationale: Evidence media is built during research and writing because plotting the data can falsify the thesis. It is not decoration applied afterwards.

distribution.rationale: Distribution media consumes one identified article version. It never precedes human finalization.

priority.note: Charts, tables, timelines, diagrams. Highest return: they improve the article itself, not only its reach.
Cheapest distribution artifact and the most reused.
6–8 page social deck. Text-in, text-out; theme carries the existing role matrix.
Programmable and cheap, but no automation surface for the product-grade route (see the multimedia benchmark).
Per-second cost, no editorial need established.
Quiz or study surface. Not modelled as an artifact kind yet; would require its own contract.

reprioritisation_criteria.trigger: An evidence visual changes a thesis during the PoC.
reprioritisation_criteria.effect: Confirms rank 1 and raises the evidence-media budget.

reprioritisation_criteria.trigger: Brief regeneration after a cosmetic article edit produces materially different text.
reprioritisation_criteria.effect: The generator is under-constrained. Fix the plan contract before adding artifact kinds.

reprioritisation_criteria.trigger: Slides cannot be produced without hand-editing the deck.
reprioritisation_criteria.effect: Demote slides below infographic; the chain is not actually text-to-text.

reprioritisation_criteria.trigger: A distribution artifact is observed asserting a claim the article never verified.
reprioritisation_criteria.effect: Stop adding kinds. The claim carry-through contract is the blocker, not throughput.

reprioritisation_criteria.trigger: Measured reader behaviour shows a kind is consumed instead of the article rather than as a door to it.
reprioritisation_criteria.effect: Demote that kind. The canonical article is the destination.
